//: LibreLane / OpenLane 2 config for the MINERVA P5 hardening run.
//verilog: Single file produced by sv2v. Yosys 0.33-era front ends reject this RTL directly (SV packages and unpacked array parameters); see asic/README.md.
//clock: 40 MHz to start. The FPGA ran at 100 MHz, but Sky130 is a different library and the first goal is a clean route, not a record. Tighten once it closes.
//floorplan: Start utilisation-driven and let the tool size the die. Flop-heavy designs need headroom; raise FP_CORE_UTIL only after a clean route.
//reset: Active-low async pad reset, synchronised inside minerva_asic_top.
//drc: Keep the default Sky130 HD standard cell library and signoff corners.
//sdc: base.sdc is replaced so the host port and the async reset are constrained explicitly.
